latestTerminalSummary:
**APPROVE.** I found no false-pass in the frozen V01 tooling, scoring, mapping, or load-gate wiring. This is not an official quality pass. Mutation still executed 0, combined-source CRAP is unrun, and live Convex/Clerk/UI stay separate.

The mapping correction is the part that had to be right. On retained `117ba020` coverage I independently got 748 functions, 426 named entries, 312 V8 roots, 10 missing observations, 11 failures, and coverage 29 up / 23 down / 696 unchanged. `const f = () => 1;` no longer borrows the outer declaration line. Nested, uncalled, ambiguous, and source-remapped cases fail closed. That is conservative failure, not credit.

**Blocking findings:** none.

**Recorded open, not a current pass.**

- **Official mutation / combined CRAP.** Severity: open gate, not a tooling defect. `quality/backend/frozen-stryker-dry-run-receipt.json` records 8457 generated, 0 executed, score null, `mutationGatePassed: false`. Historical CRAP still fails 11/748, including `previewCategoryReclassification` at CC 32. Existing receipts do not settle a HEAD or combined-source run. I did not run `pnpm quality:backend`.
- **Live-provider acceptance.** Severity: open gate. Local hashes and reporter probes cannot speak to Clerk admission or the development deployment.

**Residuals I would not block on.**

- **`scripts/backend-quality.mjs:21-38`.** `verify` re-checks whatever stages a receipt already has. A single-area mutation directory can verify as passed. README already says to treat that as area evidence only. Official `quality:backend` with no args still requires coverage plus all five areas in that receipt.
- **`scripts/backend-mutation.mjs:15`.** `reused` is hardcoded 0. Freshness comes from hashed `incremental: false` / `ignoreStatic: false`, not from the Stryker report. Timeout-only also fails the extra `Killed > 0` rule. That is stricter than “Timeout counts as detected,” not a false pass.
- **`quality/backend/README.md:48`.** It says the first row of each fixture batch is a signed public command. `convex/budgetCapacity.load.test.ts:12-33` posts once, then clones. Dataset sizes 900/99/96 and the original assertions are unchanged. Ordinary timeout remains 240s, instrumented 600s.

**Unknowns that needed a forbidden check:** actual per-area scores, instrumented load at this HEAD, and CRAP on reviewed C02/C04/F03. Those stay unknown.

**Source identity.** HEAD `308456396694d0204541b35d75538fb6d0802462`, tree `de7085542dc07cdf6dc017fc7e39e2d2a1067dd2`, base `9fbf2ea372e86459f17f086d1f4392fd51ad7cad`. Authored patch 112568 bytes / SHA-256 `b7a6a9816449255252c1e575ce01797e1bf8935f7496fca75e970a88d940d265`. Full patch 3528976 bytes / SHA-256 `8ec475387a2533790e5998a62690216f7eddcbe682b2541b10ec78404eca2dd2`. Live input digest `998e04d97d3000bd33d7280b872252f9f3b33397ff879c6f866a89d6affcbd22`. Historical freeze-manifest `60f90f07…` is the pre-mapping freeze and is not current input.

**Validation.** Read-only diff/hash inspection in `/Users/zambamon/.t3/worktrees/finance-tracker-v2/pstack-core-v01-backend-gates`. `node --test scripts/backend-quality.test.mjs`: 21 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. In-memory reporter and receipt-verifier probes only. No writes, no `crap-mapping-audit`, no `pnpm quality:backend`, no backend/load/mutation/coverage/install/build/provider/device work. Checkout remained clean. The three `period.ts` Stryker suppressions are unchanged.
